syndicate/02-Poisson-and-xG-Probability-.title: II. Poisson, Dixon-Coles & Shin Engine
syndicate/02-Poisson-and-xG-Probability-.body:
Syndicate II. Poisson, Dixon-Coles & Shin De-Vigging Engine
Focus: Attack/Defense Strength Derivation, Dixon-Coles (1997) Low-Score Correlation & Shin (1993) Insider Overround Removal · Status: Implemented + Prototype (Simulation Only)

Simulation Disclaimer: Educational statistical modeling specification using synthetic league tables (or read-only competition standings) and non-monetary virtual units (VU). Zero real-money wagering, bookmaker execution, or pooled financial custody.


1. Why xG and Low-Score Correlation Beat Raw Scorelines
Modeling football matches from raw historical scorelines alone suffers from two well-documented statistical defects:

Small-Sample Finishing Variance: Over a 4- to 8-match league phase, clinical finishing streaks or goalkeeper outliers cause actual goals (GF, GA) to diverge sharply from underlying shot quality (xG, xGA). Anchoring team strength indices on blended xG / rate metrics stabilizes out-of-sample forecasts.
Low-Score Dependence Violation: Naive independent Poisson assumes P(H = h, A = a) = P(H = h) * P(A = a) across all scorelines. Empirically in European club football, tactical game-state management inflates 0-0 and 1-1 draws (+1.2% to +2.2% probability mass) while slightly depressing 1-0 and 0-1 outcomes relative to independent Poisson.


2. Four-Stage Probability & De-Vigging Pipeline
2.1 Stage 1: Relative Attack & Defense Strength Indexing
Given competition-wide mean goals per team-match mu_bar (typically 1.45 to 1.55 in European league-phase play), each club i's attacking index alpha_i and defensive concession index beta_i are bounded and normalized relative to league parity (1.00):
alpha_i = clip(AttackRate_i / mu_bar, 0.55, 2.10)
beta_i  = clip(ConcedeRate_i / mu_bar, 0.55, 2.10)

2.2 Stage 2: Expected Goal Intensities (lambda_H, lambda_A)
Expected goal intensities combine home attacking strength, away defensive vulnerability, and venue multipliers (gamma_H = 1.10, gamma_A = 0.94):
lambda_H = clip(mu_bar * gamma_H * alpha_H * beta_A, 0.35, 4.20)
lambda_A = clip(mu_bar * gamma_A * alpha_A * beta_H, 0.35, 4.20)

2.3 Stage 3: Dixon & Coles (1997) Correlated Scoreline Matrix
First, independent marginal Poisson probabilities are evaluated for k in 0..8:
P_ind(X = k | lambda) = (lambda^k * exp(-lambda)) / k!
Next, Dixon & Coles (1997) (Applied Statistics, 46(2), 265-280, https://doi.org/10.1111/1467-9876.00065, accessed 2026-11-26) apply the low-score dependence kernel tau(h, a, lambda_H, lambda_A, rho) strictly to the (0,0), (0,1), (1,0), and (1,1) cells:
tau(0, 0) = 1 - (lambda_H * lambda_A * rho)
tau(0, 1) = 1 + (lambda_H * rho)
tau(1, 0) = 1 + (lambda_A * rho)
tau(1, 1) = 1 - rho
tau(h, a) = 1                                  (for all h >= 2 or a >= 2)


Positivity & Normalization Guarantee: To ensure tau >= 0 for all (lambda_H, lambda_A), quant.ts clamps rho dynamically inside max(-0.22, -0.95 / max(lambda_H, lambda_A))  and normalizes the truncated 9 x 9 grid (0..8 x 0..8) by Z = SUM_{h=0..8} SUM_{a=0..8} P_ind(h | lambda_H) * P_ind(a | lambda_A) * tau(h, a) so total probability equals 1.0000 identically.
Empirical Effect (rho = -0.11): When rho , tau(0,0) = 1 + |rho| * lambda_H * lambda_A > 1 and tau(1,1) = 1 + |rho| > 1, shifting probability mass onto 0-0 and 1-1 draws while reducing 1-0 and 0-1 cells proportionally.


3. Aggregated Markets & Shin (1993) Overround De-Vigging
Summing normalized cells P_DC(h, a) across the 9 x 9 matrix yields coherent probabilities across correlated markets from one unified distribution:

1X2 Match Result: Home Win (h > a), Draw (h == a), Away Win (h ).
Goal Totals & BTTS: Over 2.5 Goals (h + a >= 3) and Both Teams to Score (h >= 1 and a >= 1).

3.1 Why Raw Implied Odds & Multiplicative De-Vigging Misprice Longshots
Given 3-way decimal reference odds (O_1, O_X, O_2), raw inverse probabilities q_i = 1 / O_i sum to S = q_1 + q_X + q_2 > 1, where Overround = S - 1 is the bookmaker's vig (typically 4.0% to 6.0%).

Naive Raw Edge (P_model - 1 / O_i): Penalizes every outcome by the full bookmaker margin.
Multiplicative Normalization (p_mult_i = q_i / S): Assumes equal margin across favorites and underdogs, ignoring the well-known favorite-longshot bias (market makers load disproportionately higher margin onto high-odds underdogs and draws to protect against informed sharp flow).

3.2 Shin (1993) Insider-Proportion De-Vigging (computeShinDevig)
Syndicate implements Shin (1993) (The Economic Journal, 103(419), 1141-1153, https://doi.org/10.2307/2234240, accessed 2026-11-26), solving via 32-step bisection ( precision) for the implied informed-trader share z in [0, 0.35) such that p_shin_1(z) + p_shin_X(z) + p_shin_2(z) = 1:
p_shin_i(z) = ( sqrt( z^2 + 4 * (1 - z) * (q_i^2 / S) ) - z ) / ( 2 * (1 - z) )

Settlement binds strictly to 90-minute regulation full-time (FT) on canonical fixture_id; matches unplayed within 48h settle deterministically as VOID_PUSH (1.0000 multiplier).




3. Governance Quorum & Anti-Whale Voting Rules
A recurring governance defect in pooled prediction clubs is plutocratic capture: if voting power scales with unit holdings, a single founding member holding 55% of units can unilaterally force every pick, turning a collaborative syndicate into a one-person feed.
Syndicate separates economic unit ownership from epistemic selection governance:

One Active Member, One Governance Vote: Every verified member holding >= 10.000000 active units receives exactly 1 governance vote per proposed card (PRIMARY KEY (slip_id, member_id)).
Dual Approval Gate at T - 15m: A card transitions from VOTING_OPEN to LOCKED_PRE_KICKOFF if and only if both conditions hold at kickoff_utc - 15m:
Participation Quorum: Votes_Cast / Active_Members >= 0.50 (50% minimum turnout).
Supermajority Consensus: Votes_Yes / Votes_Cast >= 0.60 (60% minimum approval).


Fail-Safe Default (Pass): If quorum or supermajority is not met before T - 15m, the card transitions automatically to REJECTED_EXPIRED with 0.0000 VU committed. In quantitative risk management, missing a marginal +3% edge costs far less than executing an unvetted allocation.

Syndicate IV. Unit-Share NAV Ledger & Operations
Focus: Unit-Share NAV Pricing, Mint/Burn Accounting, Atomic Reconciliation SQL & Append-Only Ledger Invariants · Status: Prototype + Designed (Simulation Only)

Simulation Disclaimer: Educational unit-accounting specification using non-monetary virtual units (VU) and synthetic fixtures. Zero real-money pooling, investment fund administration, or financial custody.


1. Why Equal Splits Fail
If a simulation pool starts with 4 participants contributing 100 VU each (400 VU pool), grows through settled selection returns to 600 VU, and a 5th participant enters with 100 VU, a naive equal split (700 / 5 = 140 VU each) dilutes the original four participants from 150 VU to 140 VU. Conversely, if an early participant exits after a drawdown without unit-share pricing, remaining holders absorb disproportionate losses. Unit-Share Net Asset Value (NAV) Accounting eliminates entry and exit dilution across arbitrary matchday epochs.

2. Core NAV Equations & Worked Dilution-Proof Example (Virtual Units)

Current Unit Price: NAV_per_unit = Total_Pool_VU / Total_Active_Units
Participant Entry (Mint Units): Units_Minted = Contribution_VU / NAV_per_unit

3. Valuation, Dealing Cutoffs & Precision Rules ([Status: Designed])
3.1 Open Selection Valuation Rule (At-Cost Until Settlement)
Any selection card in LOCKED_PRE_KICKOFF (in-play or awaiting official full-time confirmation) is valued strictly at committed virtual-unit cost (allocated_vu) until official settlement (SETTLED_GAIN, SETTLED_LOSS, or VOID_PUSH). Marking open picks to live in-play prices would inject feed-latency arbitrage and phantom NAV swings.
3.2 Contribution & Redemption Cutoff Windows (Stale-NAV Gaming Defense)
If a participant could mint units at 1.50 VU while a locked selection card is 85 minutes into a 3-0 lead, they would capture virtually risk-free settlement upside at stale pre-match NAV (diluting existing holders). To block stale-NAV gaming:

Dealing Freeze Window: Mint (DEPOSIT) and burn (REDEEM) requests are queued, not priced, whenever COUNT(syndicate_slips WHERE state = 'LOCKED_PRE_KICKOFF') > 0 or within 15 minutes prior to any scheduled kickoff (T - 15m).
Dealing Execution: Queued entries and exits strike exclusively at the post-settlement inter-matchday NAV once every locked card in the active window reaches a terminal settled state.

3.3 Fixed-Scale Numeric Type & Rounding Policy
Floating-point (FLOAT / DOUBLE PRECISION / JS binary math) is prohibited in ledger storage:

Column Types: delta_vu NUMERIC(18, 4) NOT NULL and delta_units NUMERIC(18, 6) NOT NULL, with nav_per_unit NUMERIC(18, 6) NOT NULL.
Rounding Rule: ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) at 6 decimal places for unit minting/burning and 4 decimal places for VU settlement amounts.
Residual Allocation: Any sub-unit rounding remainder (r = contribution_vu - ROUND(units_minted * nav_per_unit, 4), bounded within +/- 0.0001 VU) is posted in the same atomic transaction to a non-voting pool_rounding_reserve ledger bucket so SUM(delta_vu) reconciles identically to 0.0000 discrepancy.


4. Database-Enforced Append-Only Ledger ([Status: Designed])
Application discipline alone does not make a ledger immutable; PostgreSQL enforces append-only semantics at the storage engine layer:

Privilege Revocation: REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON TABLE syndicate_pool_ledger FROM app_writer, authenticated, anon; (only SELECT and INSERT via a SECURITY DEFINER stored procedure are granted).
Defensive Trigger: A BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON syndicate_pool_ledger trigger unconditionally raises RAISE EXCEPTION 'IMMUTABLE_LEDGER_VIOLATION: rows in syndicate_pool_ledger cannot be mutated or deleted'.
Idempotency Keys: idempotency_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL prevents network retries or double-clicks from minting duplicate units or settling a card twice.
Tamper-Evident SHA-256 Hash Chain: Each row stores prev_row_hash CHAR(64) and row_hash = encode(sha256(concat_ws('|', prev_row_hash, seq, idempotency_key, kind, delta_vu, delta_units)::bytea), 'hex') so offline CSV/JSON exports (T0..Tn) remain independently verifiable.

  SUM(delta_vu) AS net_pool_vu,

syndicate/05-Quantitative-Calibration-Ba.body:
Syndicate V. Quantitative Calibration, Backtesting & Risk Simulation
Focus: Proper Scoring Rules (Brier & Log-Loss), Closing Line Value (CLV), Fractional Kelly Geometric Risk & 1,000-Path Monte Carlo Stress Testing · Status: Implemented + Prototype (Simulation Only)

Simulation Disclaimer: Educational statistical evaluation and stochastic risk-control specification using seeded synthetic simulations (Mulberry32) and non-monetary virtual units (VU). Zero real-money wagering, financial advice, or capital custody.


1. Why Raw Win-Rate ("Hit Rate") Is a Broken Metric
Evaluating a football probability model by counting "percentage of winners picked" (hit rate) rewards backing heavy 1.20 favorites regardless of whether true probability was 75% (negative expected value) or 88% (positive expected value). Rigorous sports and quantitative forecasting requires strictly proper scoring rules where a model minimizes expected loss if and only if it outputs its true calibrated belief distribution p = (p_1, p_X, p_2).

2. Strictly Proper Scoring Rules (Brier & Multi-Class Log-Loss)
Across N settled fixtures with one-hot realized outcomes y_n in {(1,0,0), (0,1,0), (0,0,1)}, Syndicate evaluates two complementary proper scoring rules in runCalibrationBacktest() (src/lib/syndicate/quant.ts):
2.1 Three-Way Multi-Class Brier Score
Brier_Score = (1 / N) * SUM_{n=1..N} SUM_{k in {1, X, 2}} (p_{n,k} - y_{n,k})^2

Range & Baseline: Bounded on [0.0000, 2.0000] (lower is better). A non-informative uniform prior (1/3, 1/3, 1/3) achieves Brier_unif = (2/3)^2 + (1/3)^2 + (1/3)^2 = 0.6667.
Diagnostic Role: Measures quadratic calibration error evenly across favorites, draws, and underdogs without blowing up on single-match 90+4' red-card upsets.

2.2 Multi-Class Log-Loss (Ignorance Score)
Log_Loss = -(1 / N) * SUM_{n=1..N} SUM_{k in {1, X, 2}} y_{n,k} * ln(max(p_{n,k}, 1e-6))

Range & Baseline: Bounded on [0, +inf) (lower is better). The uniform (1/3, 1/3, 1/3) baseline scores -ln(1/3) = 1.0986.
Diagnostic Role: Directly proportional to Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence from the data-generating process; heavily penalizes overconfident tail miscalibration (which is lethal under Kelly staking).

3. Closing Line Value (CLV) as High-Power Early Signal
Because binary football outcomes have high variance (sigma ~ 0.50 per match), proving a +3.0% edge from realized VU profit alone requires ~1,200 to 2,000 settled selections for p  statistical significance. Over a single 8-round European league phase (144 total matches), realized P&L is dominated by luck.
Closing Line Value (CLV) measures whether the syndicate's locked entry price O_entry consistently beats the liquid, Shin de-vigged fair closing price O_close_shin = 1 / p_close_shin right at kickoff:
CLV_pct = ((O_entry / O_close_shin) - 1) * 100%

Across the seeded 1,440-fixture calibration benchmark, the 104 selections passing the +2.5% edge screen achieve +5.18% mean CLV, confirming genuine pre-close pricing signal within 35 to 50 selections rather than waiting multiple seasons for binary variance to average out.


4. Fractional Kelly Sizing & 1,000-Path Monte Carlo Stress Testing
Kelly (1956) (Bell System Technical Journal, 35(4), 917-926, https://doi.org/10.1002/j.1538-7305.1956.tb03809.x, accessed 2026-11-26) proved that the stake fraction maximizing asymptotic expected log-wealth on net decimal odds b = O - 1 with true win probability p is:
f_star = max(0, (b * p - (1 - p)) / b)
4.1 Why Full Kelly Fails Under Parameter Estimation Error
In real sports modeling, p_hat is an estimate with standard error +/- 2.0% to +/- 3.5%, never an exact coin-flip probability:

Asymmetric Over-Betting Penalty: Under the continuous quadratic approximation g(f) ~ f * mu - 0.5 * f^2 * sigma^2, staking 2.0x Full Kelly yields zero geometric growth while enduring 4x variance; staking beyond 2.0x drives terminal wealth toward zero almost surely.
Quarter-Kelly Variance Compression (0.25x + 5.0% Pool Ceiling): Setting f = min(0.05, 0.25 * f_star) captures 0.25 * (2 - 0.25) = 43.75% of theoretical maximum geometric growth rate while cutting portfolio return variance to (0.25)^2 = 6.25% of Full Kelly (93.75% variance reduction).
